name: Financial Inclusion and Poverty Analysis
description: Research that involves combining World Bank Global Findex data and the Poverty and Inequality Platform (PIP) data to analyze the relationships between financial inclusion and poverty across countries.

variableMeasured.name: account_pct
variableMeasured.description: Percentage of residents over 15 years old that have an account

variableMeasured.name: bank_account_pct
variableMeasured.description: Percentage of residents with a bank account

variableMeasured.name: mobile_account_pct
variableMeasured.description: Percentage of residents with a mobile money account

variableMeasured.name: digital_account_pct
variableMeasured.description: Percentage of residents with a digitally-enabled account

variableMeasured.name: poverty_headcount
variableMeasured.description: Proportion of population that falls below the poverty line

variableMeasured.name: gini
variableMeasured.description: Income inequality measured as a 0 or 1
